Microsoft Distributable Code - CodeConvoy Windows releases
========================================================

Scope and ownership
-------------------
Microsoft Corporation owns the Microsoft startup and support code incorporated
in these Windows binaries. CodeConvoy.exe (x64, in both the installer and ZIP)
and codeconvoy_utils.dll (x86, installer only) dynamically use the VC/UCRT, but
still incorporate startup/support objects selected from msvcrt.lib and Windows
SDK libraries. CodeConvoyAppId.dll uses SDK import libraries and UUID data without
a CRT. The recorded toolset is MSVC 14.51.36231 with Windows SDK 10.0.26100.0.

The setup stub, uninstaller and prebuilt NSIS plugins have separately recorded
provenance gaps for any embedded Microsoft code. An absence of CRT DLL imports
does not establish that they contain no Microsoft code. The inventory records
these limits; this notice does not declare every native file's inputs known or
every observed input licensed as Distributable Code.

VCRUNTIME140.dll and the Windows UCRT are supplied separately by the user or
operating system. These packages contain no separate Microsoft runtime DLLs or
redistributable installer. This notice concerns incorporated Microsoft code;
it does not grant rights to redistribute separately obtained runtime files.

CodeConvoy's original code and artwork remain under the MIT license in
LICENSE.txt. That grant does not license Microsoft's code. Other third-party
components retain their own licenses. The Microsoft-specific conditions below
do not relicense CodeConvoy's source or restrict rights granted for independent
MIT or other open-source components.

Redistribution conditions
-------------------------
Redistribution of Microsoft Distributable Code depends on the applicable
development-tool/component agreement and its distributable list. Inclusion in
a linked binary is not itself a redistribution grant. Subject to that grant:

- Distribute authorized, unmodified Microsoft object code with an application
  providing substantial primary functionality. For SDK .lib inputs, distribute
  the linked program, not the libraries. SDK code supplied in a setup program
  must remain within that unmodified setup program.
- Preserve Microsoft's copyright, patent and trademark notices. SDK terms
  also require a valid copyright notice for the distributing application.
- Do not imply Microsoft authorship or endorsement through product naming or
  branding. SDK Distributable Code is restricted to Microsoft's operating
  system platform and must not be used in malicious, deceptive or unlawful
  programs.
- Do not modify or distribute Microsoft source in a way that subjects it to
  a license requiring source disclosure/distribution or granting others the
  right to modify that source (an Excluded License). This does not prohibit
  independently licensed CodeConvoy source from remaining MIT licensed.
- The reviewed VS 2026 terms exclude unreleased components, software developed
  with Insiders Channel Software, and software dependent on unreleased
  components. The VS distributable list also excludes preview components.

Recipients and distributors
--------------------------
Distributors must obtain downstream distributors' and external end users'
agreement to terms providing Microsoft Distributable Code protection no weaker
than the applicable Microsoft agreement. Passing on this notice communicates
conditions; its presence alone does not establish that such agreement occurred
or that a complete protective set of terms has been provided.

The distributing licensee also owes Microsoft the defense and indemnification
undertakings specified by its agreement, including related legal costs. The
reviewed VS 2026 clause excepts claims based solely on Distributable Code; the
reviewed SDK clause does not state that exception. These are the distributor's
contractual responsibilities, not an indemnity imposed on ordinary end users
by this notice. Applicable trade/export laws and controlling component terms
must also be observed.

This original notice summarizes the relevant distribution conditions. It is
not a Microsoft license, a substitute for the controlling agreements, or a
declaration that CodeConvoy's redistribution rights and recipient arrangements
have been established. The windows-crt publication blocker remains active.
